|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることもできる。</span>''



<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Han Seeker.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on the opponent's side, limited to an unexplored location card. During your control phase, it may move like a character by using Force. When it reaches the same location as Han Solo or an alien with ability less than 3, choose one of them to be lost. Han Seeker is also lost.

'''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track specified individuals or targets meeting specified conditions. Heat and optical sensors track targets with great accuracy. It can also be smuggled aboard a starship.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese describes an unexplored location card for deployment, while the English specifies an unoccupied site. The Japanese names Han Solo; the English says Han. The English explicitly says the chosen target is immediately lost, while the Japanese does not specify immediately.
